title: Rectangular Multispectral Perturbation Theory
summary: We provide a first systematic treatment of so-called rectangular multispectral perturbation theory. With their paper from 2003, Hochstenbach and Plestenjak ["Backward Error, Condition Numbers, and Pseudospectra for the Multiparameter Eigenvalue Problem" in Linear Algebra and its Applications] extended perturbation theory from one-parameter eigenvalue problems to multiple spectral parameters. After two decades, we take it one step further and consider a different manifestation of the multiparameter eigenvalue problem that consists of one matrix equation with rectangular coefficient matrices.…
